certification.name: OSINT Industries OSINT Training
certification.description: Practitioner-led OSINT training of about 18 hours over three days, built from modules such as OSINT Fundamentals, Advanced OSINT and OSINT for ICAC analysts. Course-based, with hands-on exercises; some courses end in an assessment such as a CTF or a quiz.
certification.currency_note: Bespoke training built from modules; price on request
